metadata.description: Arkad plugins for Claude Code and Cowork — internal tools, branded documents, content rules and project scaffolding.

plugins.name: arkad-tools
plugins.description: Arkad internal tools through the OAuth-protected Arkad MCP Gateway: site checks, CRM lookups and a connection check. One connector, GitHub-org login, works in Claude Code, Cowork chat and scheduled tasks.

plugins.name: arkad-documents
plugins.description: Generate branded Arkad documents — starting with an internal memo — as print-ready A4 HTML from the templates shipped inside the plugin. No connector or secret.

plugins.name: arkad-content
plugins.description: Write and check posts in the Arkad voice: a de-slop pass that removes AI phrasing and a pre-publish review with a small linter. The rules ship inside the plugin; no connector or secret.

plugins.name: arkad-dev
plugins.description: Scaffold a new Arkad code project with the same governance as this repo — AGENTS.md, specs, ADRs, changelog — and create the GitHub repository. Claude Code only: it needs a local shell and git.
